findings.title: Floating promise in the catch block can crash the process
findings.why_it_matters: notifyOps returns a promise that is neither awaited nor caught. If the ops notification fails, the rejection is unhandled, which terminates the Node process — and it happens precisely on the error path, where reliability matters most.
findings.suggested_fix: await notifyOps(...) inside the catch, or attach a .catch() as trackAsync does.
